news.title: A Big Gamble for the Left: Can Socialism Appeal in a Swing State?
news.summary: Francesca Hong, a state legislator running for governor of Wisconsin, wants to prove that a democratic socialist can win in a battleground. Some say she would hand the race to Republicans.
